title.zh: Mistral发布Voxtral 3：把语音识别、推理和工具调用接成实时Agent

current_state.zh: Mistral 发布了 Voxtral 3，这是一个模块化语音栈，包含转录模型、语音合成模型和基于 LiveKit 的 Voice Agent SDK，支持 50 多种语言的转录与实时语音 Agent；该模型仍为闭源。
current_state.en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech stack with transcription models, a synthesis model, and a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK, supporting 50+ languages for transcription and real-time voice agents; the model remains closed-source.

updates.what_changed_zh: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3，这是一款升级版语音模型，提供转写、说话人分离和语音生成能力，但仍为闭源。
updates.what_changed_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, an upgraded speech model offering transcription, diarization, and speech-generation capabilities, though it remains closed-source.
updates.current_state_zh: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3，这是一款升级版语音模型，提供转写、说话人分离和语音生成能力，但仍为闭源。
updates.current_state_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, an upgraded speech model offering transcription, diarization, and speech-generation capabilities, though it remains closed-source.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Mistral released Voxtral 3, an upgraded speech model offering transcription, diarization, and speech-generation capabilities, though it remains closed-source.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, an upgraded speech model offering transcription, diarization, and speech-generation capabilities, though it remains closed-source.

updates.title_zh: Mistral发布Voxtral 3：把语音识别、推理和工具调用接成实时Agent
updates.title_en: Mistral发布Voxtral 3：把语音识别、推理和工具调用接成实时Agent
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增披露 Voxtral 3 为模块化语音栈，包含三款转录模型、一款语音合成模型和基于 LiveKit 的 Voice Agent SDK；转录支持 50 多种语言，语音合成支持 35 种以上语言和 50 多种方言，并公布 API 定价。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details that Voxtral 3 is a modular speech stack with three transcription models, a synthesis model, and a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK; transcription supports 50+ languages, synthesis supports 35+ languages and 50+ dialects, with API pricing disclosed.
updates.current_state_zh: Mistral 发布了 Voxtral 3，这是一个模块化语音栈，包含转录模型、语音合成模型和基于 LiveKit 的 Voice Agent SDK，支持 50 多种语言的转录与实时语音 Agent；该模型仍为闭源。
updates.current_state_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech stack with transcription models, a synthesis model, and a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK, supporting 50+ languages for transcription and real-time voice agents; the model remains closed-source.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech-to-speech stack with transcription and synthesis models plus a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK for real-time tool-calling agents.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech-to-speech stack with transcription and synthesis models plus a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK for real-time tool-calling agents.
